steps.title: Documents (web) — upload, category, audience, schedule, delete; announcements attach a document
steps.goal: Every active member sees a Documents entry in the org navigation and, at `/o/<slug>/documents`, the documents published to an audience they belong to, filterable by category, with Open (PDF, images) or Download (Word, Excel, text) buttons on one-hour signed URLs. A `documents.upload` holder uploads files up to 50 MB from the eight-type allow-list with title, category, audience group and publish time (now or scheduled), edits that metadata, resumes or discards incomplete uploads, and deletes documents (objects removed by the cron drain). Announcement managers attach a published document to an announcement through a real picker (replacing 3.5a's disabled placeholder) with an audience-mismatch warning, and announcement lists show a paper-clip link. `@church/db` gains `queries/documents.ts` (deferred by 1.7a). Documents never push — `notification_kind` has no `document` value — and the UI says so.
steps.prompt:
You are working in the ChurchAppCLD repository. CLAUDE.md loads `new_session_instructions.md` and `HANDOFF.md` automatically — follow the session-start checklist (new-session.sh, prompt_history.txt). Work on `main` unless I have named another branch in this session. This is step 5.4a "Documents (web) — upload, category, audience, schedule, delete; announcements attach a document" of `docs/TODO.md`; read that step's 'Done when' list first. Read `docs/PLAN.md` §4 (Content tables, "Permission mapping"), §6, §8 and §11 item (4), and `docs/DESIGN.md` §4.2 (Content table), §6 (the `documents` row and the "Storage policies" paragraph), §7 (bucket table and "Uploads"), §9 and §11 Phase 2 before writing code. Build ONLY this step; do not start the next one.

## Goal
When you finish, every active member of a church sees a **Documents** entry in the org navigation and, at `/o/<slug>/documents`, the documents published to an audience they belong to, filterable by category, with an Open button (PDF and images open in a new tab) or a Download button (Word, Excel and text files, which browsers cannot render) backed by one-hour signed URLs. A leader holding `documents.upload` can upload a file of up to 50 MB from the allow-list (PDF, JPG, PNG, TXT, Word, Excel) with a title, an optional category, an audience group and a publish time (now or scheduled), edit that metadata later, resume or discard an incomplete upload, and delete a document (the object is removed by the cron drain). Announcement managers can attach a published document to an announcement: 3.5a's disabled "Attach a document" placeholder becomes a real picker and the announcement lists show a paper-clip link that opens the document. Documents never send a push on their own — `notification_kind` has no `document` value — so the form says so and points at "create an announcement and attach this document". The mobile app is untouched (5.4b).

## Inputs / prior state
- Org shell and guards (2.1a/3.1): `requireOrgMember(slug)` → `OrgContext` (the org id is spelled `org.orgId` or `org.org_id` — read `src/lib/auth/require-org.ts` and use the field that exists), `requirePerm(ctx, perm)`, `requireWritable(ctx)`, `isWritable(ctx)`, `hasPerm(ctx, perm)`, `hasAnyPerm(ctx, perms)` from `src/lib/auth/require-perm.ts`; `getAuthContext().userId` (2.1a, `src/lib/auth/context.ts`) for `created_by`; `NAV_ITEMS` in `src/features/org/nav.ts` (slug-relative `href`, e.g. 3.5b's `{ href: 'bulletins', label: 'Bulletins', requires: undefined }`); `ActionResult` / `toActionError` in `src/lib/actions/result.ts`; `src/lib/dates.ts` (`zonedLocalToInstant`, `instantToZonedLocal`, `formatInstantInZone` — the only date helpers in the web app; add none).
- 3.3b's generic uploader — reuse, do not write another: `src/features/uploads/tus.ts` (`startTusUpload`), `src/features/uploads/ResumableUpload.tsx` (props `{ file, bucket, objectName, contentType, onDone(), onError(key: UploadErrorKey), onCancel() }`), `src/features/uploads/upload-errors.ts` (`UploadErrorKey`, `uploadErrorToKey`, `uploadErrorMessage(key)` — lifted there by 3.5b), and `statObject(db, bucket, path)` in `packages/db/src/queries/storage.ts`.
- 3.5b's bulletin feature is the template: `src/features/bulletins/{form-schema,actions,UploadBulletinForm,BulletinsTable,OpenBulletin}` — copy the patterns (prepare → tus → finalize, `resolveBulletinMime`, the popup-safe `window.open('', '_blank', 'noopener')` BEFORE the `await`, Resume/Discard for incomplete rows, the `…Action` suffix when `@church/db` owns the plain name), not the components.
- 3.5a's announcements: `src/features/announcements/{AnnouncementForm,form-schema,actions,AnnouncementsTable,AudienceGroupSelect}`; `toAnnouncementInput` currently hard-codes `document_id: null` and the form renders a disabled "Attach a document" placeholder (G9's hand-off: "5.4 must add the document picker to `AnnouncementForm` and a `listDocumentOptions` query"). The UI never writes `audience_group_id = null`; "All attendees" is the system group with kind `everyone`.
- `@church/domain` (1.6a/1.6b): `limits.ts` — `BUCKETS.documents` (`fileSizeLimitBytes` = 52428800; `allowedMimeTypes` = exactly the eight values of `9999_init.sql` section (10): `application/pdf`, `image/jpeg`, `image/png`, `text/plain`, `application/msword`, `application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document`, `application/vnd.ms-excel`, `application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet`), `readMaxUploadMb`, `MAX_UPLOAD_MB_DEFAULT`, `extensionForMime`, `isAllowedMime(bucket, mime)`, `bulletinPath(orgId, bulletinId, uuid, ext)` — check whether a `documentPath(orgId, documentId, uuid, ext)` → `${orgId}/documents/${documentId}/${uuid}.${ext}` exists beside it; if not, add it additively with a test and record it; `schemas/document.ts` — `documentSchema` (`title`, `description` ≤ 4000 nullable, `category` ≤ 60 nullable, `audience_group_id` nullable, `mime_type` / `file_size_bytes` against the `documents` bucket, `publish_at`); `schemas/announcement.ts` — `announcementSchema.document_id` nullable uuid; `errors.ts` — `toDomainError`, `DomainErrorKey`, `errorMessageFor`.
- `@church/db` (1.7a): `queries/documents.ts` does NOT exist — 1.7a deferred it to this step ("Phase 2/3 modules `calendars-events.ts`, `documents.ts` and `audit.ts` are NOT written here"); `keys.ts` already has `queryKeys.documents.list(orgId)`; `queries/audience-groups.ts` — `listAudienceGroups(db, orgId)` (system rows first, then custom); `queries/storage.ts` — `createSignedUrl(db, bucket, path, { ttl, download? })` → `{ url, expiresAt }`, `statObject`; `queries/settings.ts` — `getSettings(db, orgId)` (`timezone`); `queries/announcements.ts` — `insertAnnouncement`, `updateAnnouncement`, `listAnnouncements`, `listFeed`, `getAnnouncement`.
- Database facts — read `supabase/migrations/9999_init.sql` sections (3), (5), (7), (8) and (10) for `documents` and confirm each before coding. DESIGN §4.2 defines `documents` as the `bulletins` shape "with `category, audience_group_id`; path check + unique", so expect `id, org_id, title, category, audience_group_id null (fk audience_groups), storage_path (like org_id::text || '/documents/' || id::text || '/%', unique), mime_type, file_size_bytes, publish_at default now(), created_by`; `description` exists only if 1.2 added it — if the column is missing, drop `description` from the form and (additively, with a test, recorded) from `documentSchema`. `publish_at` must be nullable for the draft row (3.5b verified the same for `bulletins`); if it is `not null`, stop and ask me — a `drop not null` migration needs a number from the HANDOFF ledger. RLS (DESIGN §6): select = member ∧ `publish_at <= now()` ∧ `app.user_in_group(audience_group_id)`, or `documents.upload`; insert/update/delete = `documents.upload` ∧ writable. Storage: `ca_storage_insert` → `app.can_write_object('documents', name)` = a `documents` row whose `storage_path` equals `name` exactly plus `documents.upload`; `ca_storage_select` → `app.can_read_object` = the document row is visible to the caller; no update/delete for `authenticated` — deletion only through the `documents_enqueue_storage_deletion` trigger → `storage_deletions` → 3.6b's cron drain. Check whether `assert_same_org` triggers guard `documents.audience_group_id` and `announcements.document_id`; if `announcements.document_id` has no same-org guard the Server Action must verify the document's `org_id` itself (do it anyway — defence in depth). Check the FK action on `announcements.document_id` (`set null` vs `restrict`) — Build 4 depends on it. There is NO `on_content_publish` trigger on `documents` (`notification_kind` = `announcement, event, survey, bulletin`): documents never enqueue a push. `app.user_in_group(null)` is true (DESIGN §4.3): a null audience means every member.
- Founder decision 10 (Supabase Free): the project-wide upload limit is 50 MB, the `documents` bucket cap is 50 MiB and `NEXT_PUBLIC_MAX_UPLOAD_MB` defaults to 50 — the effective cap is `Math.min(BUCKETS.documents.fileSizeLimitBytes, readMaxUploadMb(process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_MAX_UPLOAD_MB) * 1024 * 1024)`; map the storage "exceeds plan limit" error exactly as 3.3b does (its `UploadErrorKey`). Decision 7: only `suspended` blocks writes.

## Build
1. **`packages/db/src/queries/documents.ts`** (client first, explicit column lists, `unwrap`; tests in `queries/documents.test.ts` with a mocked client asserting the filters built): `listDocuments(db, orgId, { includeDrafts?: boolean; category?: string | null; limit?; offset? })` ordered `publish_at desc nulls first` (uploaders see drafts and scheduled rows — RLS decides); `listPublishedDocuments(db, orgId, { category?, limit? })` = `publish_at <= now()` ordered `publish_at desc` (the member query, reused by 5.4b); `getDocument(db, id)`; `insertDocumentDraft(db, { id, org_id, title, description?, category, audience_group_id, storage_path, mime_type, file_size_bytes, publish_at: null, created_by })` (the CALLER supplies `id` — same rule as sermons/bulletins); `finalizeDocument(db, id, { mime_type, file_size_bytes, publish_at })`; `updateDocument(db, id, { title?, description?, category?, audience_group_id?, publish_at? })`; `deleteDocument(db, id)`; `listDocumentOptions(db, orgId)` → `{ id, title, category, audience_group_id, publish_at }[]` for the announcement picker (published or scheduled, never drafts); `listDocumentCategories(db, orgId)` → distinct non-null `category` values sorted (select the column and dedupe in TypeScript — no RPC); `countAnnouncementsForDocument(db, documentId)` (put it in `queries/announcements.ts`). Add `queryKeys.documents.detail(id)` and `queryKeys.documents.categories(orgId)` additively to `keys.ts`; keep `queryKeys.documents.list(orgId)` as is. Export the module from `packages/db/src/index.ts` and fix the README line that said documents were deferred.
2. **Domain additions (only if missing; each with a test):** `documentPath(...)` in `limits.ts`; a new `packages/domain/src/documents.ts` with `documentKind(mime)` → `'pdf' | 'image' | 'text' | 'word' | 'excel'` and `DOCUMENT_KIND_LABELS` (pure; 5.4b uses the same so both apps label files identically); `documentCategorySchema = z.string().trim().min(1).max(60)`. Export from `packages/domain/src/index.ts`.
3. **Form schema** `apps/web/src/features/documents/form-schema.ts`: `documentUploadFormSchema` = `{ title 1–160, description optional ≤ 4000 (only if the column exists), category optional (documentCategorySchema), audience_group_id uuid (required in the UI — store the `everyone` system group for "All attendees", never null, as 3.5a does), publish_mode: 'now' | 'schedule', publish_at_local (`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm`, required when 'schedule'), file_name, mime_type ∈ BUCKETS.documents.allowedMimeTypes, file_size_bytes ≤ effective cap }` with the message "Documents can be PDF, JPG, PNG, TXT, Word or Excel files up to 50 MB"; `documentEditFormSchema` = the metadata subset plus `publish_mode`/`publish_at_local`; `toDocumentInput(form, tz, now)` producing what `documentSchema` accepts; `resolveDocumentMime(fileName: string, reportedType: string): { ext, mime } | null` — pure, string arguments so the Server Action re-runs it (mirror `resolveBulletinMime`): trust `reportedType` when non-empty and `isAllowedMime('documents', reportedType)`, else map the lowercase extension (`pdf`, `jpg`/`jpeg`, `png`, `txt`, `doc`, `docx`, `xls`, `xlsx`) to its canonical MIME, else `null`; `ext = extensionForMime(mime)`. Browsers often report an empty type for `.docx`/`.xlsx` on Linux — the extension fallback is what makes those uploads work. Tests: every mapped MIME is in `BUCKETS.documents.allowedMimeTypes`; `webp`, `svg`, `zip`, `exe` and a 51 MB file are refused; `resolveDocumentMime('Minutes.DOCX', '')` → the docx MIME.
4. **Server Actions** `src/features/documents/actions.ts` (`'use server'`; `requireOrgMember` → `requirePerm(ctx, 'documents.upload')` → `requireWritable` → user client → `ActionResult`; `getSettings` for `timezone`):
   - `prepareDocumentUpload(orgSlug, form)`: validate; `id = crypto.randomUUID()`; recompute `{ ext, mime }` server-side (reject `null` with `upload_mime_not_allowed`); `storagePath = documentPath(orgId, id, crypto.randomUUID(), ext)`; resolve the intended publish instant (`now` → null here, applied at finalize; `schedule` → ISO via `zonedLocalToInstant`); `insertDocumentDraft(...)` with `publish_at: null`; return `{ documentId, storagePath, contentType, publishAt }`. 23505 on the path → retry once with a new uuid; 23514 → field error; 23503 on `audience_group_id` → "That audience group no longer exists".
   - `finalizeDocumentUpload(orgSlug, { documentId, file_size_bytes, mime_type, publishAt })`: `getDocument` → same org and `publish_at null`; `statObject(db, 'documents', storage_path)` must report the object (else 3.5b's `upload_incomplete` key or `invalid_payload` with "The file has not finished uploading"); `finalizeDocument(db, id, { mime_type, file_size_bytes, publish_at: publishAt ?? new Date().toISOString() })`; `revalidatePath('/o/<slug>/documents')`; return `{ scheduled: boolean }` for the toast ("Document published" / "Document scheduled for <local time>"). Do NOT call `afterContentPublish` — nothing is enqueued for documents.
   - `discardDocumentUpload(orgSlug, documentId)`: only rows with `publish_at null`; `deleteDocument`.
   - `updateDocumentAction(orgSlug, documentId, form)`: `documentEditFormSchema` → `updateDocument`; 0 rows → "You no longer have permission to manage documents".
   - `deleteDocumentAction(orgSlug, documentId)`: `countAnnouncementsForDocument` first; the confirm dialog says "N announcements link to this document; the link disappears" when the FK is `on delete set null`, or the action refuses with "Remove this document from N announcements first" when it is `restrict`; then `deleteDocument`; toast "Deleted. The file is removed by the maintenance job within a few minutes; members who already downloaded it keep their copy".
   - `mintDocumentUrl(orgSlug, documentId, { download }: { download: boolean })`: `requireOrgMember` only (RLS on `storage.objects` decides who may read); `getDocument` → `not_found` when RLS hides it (never a hint that it exists); `createSignedUrl(db, 'documents', storage_path, { ttl: SIGNED_URL_TTL_SECONDS, download: download ? '<title slug>.<ext>' : undefined })` → `{ url, expiresAt }`.
5. **UploadDocumentForm** `src/features/documents/UploadDocumentForm.tsx` (client; RHF + `zodResolver(documentUploadFormSchema)`) inside a shadcn `Sheet` opened by an "Upload document" button — the route map has a single `/documents` page and no `/documents/new`: Title; Description (if the column exists); Category — text input with a `datalist` of existing categories (placeholder "e.g. Forms, Policies, Minutes"; never pre-insert values); Audience — reuse 3.5a's `AudienceGroupSelect`: move it to `src/features/audience/AudienceGroupSelect.tsx` and leave a one-line re-export at the old path so 3.5a's imports compile (5.5 feeds this same component with custom groups); default `everyone`; Publish — radio "Now" / "Schedule for" with a `datetime-local` input and the caption "Times are in <timezone>" exactly as 3.5a; file input with `accept` built from `BUCKETS.documents.allowedMimeTypes` plus `.doc,.docx,.xls,.xlsx,.txt`, the cap enforced client-side before any Server Action; the note "Documents do not send a push notification. To notify members, create an announcement and attach this document." Submit → `prepareDocumentUpload` → `ResumableUpload` (`bucket="documents"`, `objectName={storagePath}` verbatim, `contentType`) → `finalizeDocumentUpload` → toast → close + `router.refresh()`; `onError(key)` → `uploadErrorMessage(key)` with Retry (same path — tus resumes) / Discard; `onCancel` → `discardDocumentUpload`.
6. **EditDocumentDialog** `src/features/documents/EditDocumentDialog.tsx`: title, description, category, audience, publish time (a scheduled document may be moved; a published one shows "Published <time>" read-only — no unpublish in this step; say so in a comment). Calls `updateDocumentAction`.
7. **DocumentsTable** `src/features/documents/DocumentsTable.tsx`: columns Title (description as tooltip), Category (badge; filter chips above the table from `listDocumentCategories`, "All" default, state in the URL `?category=`), Kind (`documentKind` label + icon), Size (MB with one decimal), Audience (group name; "Everyone" for the `everyone` group or null — shown to uploaders only), Published (`formatInstantInZone`; badge "Scheduled" when `publish_at > now`, "Upload incomplete" when null — uploaders only), Actions: Open (`src/features/documents/OpenDocument.tsx` — for `pdf`/`image` open a blank tab synchronously inside the click handler before awaiting `mintDocumentUrl`, then set `w.location.href`; fallback `<a target="_blank" rel="noopener">` when `w` is null; for `text`/`word`/`excel` the primary button reads "Download" and passes `download: true`), Download (always), Edit / Delete / Resume (file picker requiring the same size and MIME, then `ResumableUpload` to the existing `storage_path`, then finalize) / Discard for `documents.upload` holders. Members see no Audience column, no drafts (RLS hides them anyway) and no Edit/Delete.
8. **Page** `app/(org)/o/[orgSlug]/documents/page.tsx` (server component; `await params` and `searchParams`): `requireOrgMember` (members may read); `canUpload = hasPerm(ctx, 'documents.upload')`; uploaders → `listDocuments(db, orgId, { includeDrafts: true, category })`, members → `listPublishedDocuments(db, orgId, { category })`; `listDocumentCategories`; `listAudienceGroups` for uploaders only; header + "Upload document" (uploaders; disabled with 3.1's suspended text when `!isWritable(ctx)`); empty state "No documents yet" (+ the button for uploaders). No `maxDuration` export (uploads run in the browser).
9. **Navigation**: `NAV_ITEMS` gets `{ href: 'documents', label: 'Documents', requires: undefined }` after Bulletins (every member; the page decides what they see). Leave `src/features/org/Dashboard.tsx` alone unless 3.1 left a documents placeholder there.
10. **Announcements attach a document**: in `src/features/announcements/form-schema.ts` add `document_id: z.string().uuid().nullable()` to the FORM shape and pass it through `toAnnouncementInput`; in `AnnouncementForm.tsx` replace the disabled placeholder with `DocumentPicker` (`src/features/documents/DocumentPicker.tsx`: shadcn `Select` over `listDocumentOptions` passed from the server pages `/announcements/new` and `/announcements/[id]/edit`, a "None" option, each option showing title · category · kind); when the chosen document's `audience_group_id` differs from the announcement's group and is not the `everyone` group, show the inline warning "Members outside the document's audience will see this announcement but cannot open the document" (pure `audienceMismatch(announcementGroupId, documentGroupId, everyoneGroupId): boolean` with a test). In `src/features/announcements/actions.ts` the create/update actions validate a non-null `document_id` with `getDocument` — same org, not a draft — and return `invalid_payload` otherwise. In `AnnouncementsTable.tsx` and the member feed rendering on `/announcements` add a paper-clip icon + document title that opens through `OpenDocument`; when RLS hides the document for this member the row simply shows no link (batch the lookups with one `listDocumentOptions`-style query, not one query per row).
11. **Docs**: `docs/ENV.md` — a "Documents" paragraph beside 3.3b's "Sermon uploads" and 3.5b's "Bulletins": cap = min(bucket 50 MiB, `NEXT_PUBLIC_MAX_UPLOAD_MB`), the eight allowed MIME types, Office/text files download rather than open, deletion through `storage_deletions` (3.6b drain), incomplete rows visible only to `documents.upload` holders — read the `srv_housekeeping()` body and state whether it purges incomplete `documents` rows (record the finding in HANDOFF too). `docs/RLS.md` — "Documents UI (5.4a)": the audience rule (`user_in_group`; null = everyone; the UI stores the `everyone` group), the announcement/document audience-mismatch consequence, documents never push. `docs/ACCEPTANCE_WEB.md` (3.8) — click-through: upload a PDF for "Members" → an attendee outside the group does not see it → attach it to an "All attendees" announcement → the warning appears → the attendee sees the announcement without the link.
12. **Tests** (Vitest, jsdom): `form-schema.test.ts` (Build 3); `actions.test.ts` with mocked `@church/db` and guards (prepare without `documents.upload` → `permission_denied`; suspended → `organization_suspended`; the path passed to `insertDocumentDraft` matches `^<org>/documents/<id>/[0-9a-f-]{36}\.(pdf|jpg|png|txt|doc|docx|xls|xlsx)$`; finalize refuses when `statObject` reports no object; finalize never calls `afterContentPublish`; a scheduled finalize stores the given instant; `mintDocumentUrl` returns `not_found` when `getDocument` yields nothing; delete honours the FK case you found); `UploadDocumentForm.test.tsx` (a 51 MB file is refused before any action; `ResumableUpload` receives the prepared `objectName` — mock it; the no-push note renders); `DocumentsTable.test.tsx` (member view has no Audience column and no Edit; the category filter narrows rows; Office rows show "Download", PDF rows show "Open"); `DocumentPicker.test.tsx` + `audience-mismatch.test.ts`; `queries/documents.test.ts` in `@church/db`. Playwright smoke `apps/web/e2e/documents.spec.ts` (3.7a's `smoke` project, mock env): signed-out `/o/any/documents` → `/login?next=…`; `expectStrictHeaders` on that response.

## Constraints
- Do not touch `supabase/` (no migrations; `9999_init.sql` may be frozen — check the HANDOFF ledger; if a schema fact blocks you, stop and ask rather than editing SQL), `apps/web/vercel.json`, `proxy.ts`, `next.config.ts`, CSP, `/admin`, sermons, share links, users, bulletins (beyond reading them as the pattern), `src/lib/push/*`, or `apps/mobile` (5.4b). Do not build custom group management (5.5), join codes (5.6), or any public share page for documents (not planned).
- Never hold an elevated key in the browser; every write goes through Server Actions with the user client under RLS; `mintDocumentUrl` uses the user client so `storage.objects` RLS decides.
- Reuse, do not duplicate: one uploader (`src/features/uploads/*`), one date module (`src/lib/dates.ts`), one MIME table (`BUCKETS` + `extensionForMime` / `isAllowedMime`), one audience select. Additive changes to `@church/domain` / `@church/db` only, each with a test and a HANDOFF note.
- Pins: Next 16.3, React 19.2.3, Tailwind 4, shadcn/ui, RHF + `zodResolver`, TanStack Query, Vitest 4, Playwright 1.62, `tus-js-client` as installed by 3.3b; no new dependency. No model identifiers in commits or files; no secrets; placeholders only.
- Never run `supabase db push` or `supabase db reset`.

## Verify
- `pnpm turbo lint typecheck test` → green (the new `@church/db` and `@church/domain` tests included).
- `pnpm --filter web build` → zero warnings; `/o/[orgSlug]/documents` appears in the route list.
- `pnpm --filter web test:e2e:smoke` → green, including the new `documents.spec.ts`.
- Local DB sanity (plain Postgres harness): `scripts/db/local-up.sh && scripts/db/apply-migrations.sh && scripts/db/test.sh` still green (you changed no SQL; this proves the harness still runs) and `psql "$DATABASE_URL" -c "\d public.documents"` matches the column list you coded against.
- Manual, against the founder's hosted project when available (`docs/ACCEPTANCE_WEB.md` click-through): as a `documents.upload` holder upload a two-page PDF for the "Members" group → the row shows Published; sign in as a non-member attendee → `/documents` does not list it and `mintDocumentUrl` for its id returns `not_found`; upload a `.docx` → the action reads "Download" and the file downloads with the title as its name; attach the PDF to an "All attendees" announcement → the mismatch warning shows; delete the PDF → within one cron tick the object is gone from Storage → Explorer; a 51 MB file is refused client-side with the 50 MB message.

## Finish
- `HANDOFF.md`: State — the Phase 2 line gets `documents (web) ✔ (5.4a)`; feature table — Documents: Web UI `done (5.4a)`, Mobile UI `5.4b`; "Decisions" — documents never push (announcement + attachment is the notify path), Office/text files download instead of opening, the UI stores the `everyone` group rather than null; "Deviations from plan" — `AudienceGroupSelect` moved to `src/features/audience/` (re-export kept), any column that differed from DESIGN §4.2 (`description`), every additive `@church/domain` / `@church/db` export, the FK action on `announcements.document_id`, the `srv_housekeeping` finding about incomplete document rows; a hand-off line for 5.4b naming `listPublishedDocuments`, `getDocument`, `listDocumentCategories`, `queryKeys.documents.detail`, `documentKind`.
- Tick step 5.4a in `docs/TODO.md`; write `session_log.md`; commit `feat(web): documents — upload, audience, schedule, delete; announcements attach a document`; push `main` (`git push origin main`) unless another branch was named. If something in the plan proves impossible or wrong, do the closest correct thing, record it in HANDOFF.md under "Deviations from plan", and report it in your final message.
done_when: `packages/db/src/queries/documents.ts` exists and exports `listDocuments`, `listPublishedDocuments`, `getDocument`, `insertDocumentDraft`, `finalizeDocument`, `updateDocument`, `deleteDocument`, `listDocumentOptions`, `listDocumentCategories`; `queryKeys.documents.detail(id)` and `.documents.categories(orgId)` exist; `pnpm --filter @church/db test` passes.

`/o/<slug>/documents` renders for every active member with a Documents entry in `NAV_ITEMS`; members see only published documents in their audience (no Audience column, no Edit/Delete); `documents.upload` holders see drafts, scheduled rows, Upload/Edit/Delete/Resume/Discard.

Uploading a PDF, JPG, PNG, TXT, DOC, DOCX, XLS or XLSX up to the effective cap (min of the 50 MiB bucket cap and `NEXT_PUBLIC_MAX_UPLOAD_MB`) follows insert-draft → tus upload to the exact `{org}/documents/{id}/{uuid}.{ext}` path → finalize; a 51 MB file and a `.webp`/`.zip` are refused client-side with the documented message; the plan-limit storage error is mapped to a clear message.

PDF and image rows offer Open (new tab via a popup-safe `window.open` before the await); Office and text rows offer Download with the title as the file name; `mintDocumentUrl` returns `not_found` for a document RLS hides.

steps.goal: Members open Documents from the More tab and see the documents published to an audience they belong to, grouped by category with a chip filter; the detail screen downloads the file over a one-hour signed URL into a size-checked cache and opens it with an Android ACTION_VIEW intent by MIME type (PDF, Word, Excel, text) or inline (images), falling back to the system Share sheet and then the browser. Announcement detail shows a card for a linked document (replacing 4.2a's TODO) and renders nothing when RLS hides it; the announcement card shows a paper-clip. 4.2a's `openBulletinFile` is generalised into `src/lib/open-file.ts` with the bulletin wrapper kept. steps.prompt:
You are working in the ChurchAppCLD repository. CLAUDE.md loads `new_session_instructions.md` and `HANDOFF.md` automatically — follow the session-start checklist (new-session.sh, prompt_history.txt). Work on `main` unless I have named another branch in this session. This is step 5.4b "Documents (mobile) — list by category, open or share files, linked document on announcements, More tab row" of `docs/TODO.md`; read that step's 'Done when' list first. Read `docs/PLAN.md` §6, §9 and §11 item (4), and `docs/DESIGN.md` §6 (the `documents` row and the "Storage policies" paragraph), §7 (bucket table; "Android PDF (bulletins)"), §10 and §11 Phase 2 before writing code. Build ONLY this step; do not start the next one.

## Goal
When you finish, a member opens **Documents** from the More tab of the Anacast app and sees the documents published to an audience they belong to, grouped by category with a chip filter, each row showing kind, title, size and date. Tapping a row opens a detail screen whose "Open document" button downloads the file over a one-hour signed URL and hands it to an installed viewer — PDF, Word, Excel and text through an Android `ACTION_VIEW` intent with the exact MIME type, images inline — and falls back to the system Share sheet when no app can open the type. An announcement that carries a linked document shows a document card in `announcements/[id]` (replacing 4.2a's `TODO(5.4)` comment), and a document the member may not see (audience mismatch, unpublished, deleted) is simply absent — never an error that hints it exists. Nothing changes in the database, the web app or the push pipeline: documents have no notification kind.

## Inputs / prior state
- 4.1a–4.3 produced the app shell: `supabase` client, `AppQueryProvider` (kv-store persister; `shouldPersistQuery` excludes every `queryKeys.signedUrl(…)` key), `useSession()`, `useActiveOrg()` → `{ org: { org_id, slug, name, status }, permissions, personId, householdId, orgs, switchOrg }`, `Screen` / `LoadingState` / `ErrorState` / `EmptyState`, `publicEnv()`, `src/theme.ts` + `src/theme/tokens.ts`, `LinkifiedText`, `src/lib/signed-url.ts` (`useSignedUrl(bucket, path, opts)` → `{ url, expiresAt, isExpired, remint }`, non-hook `getSignedUrl(bucket, path)`, `isSignedUrlExpired`), `src/features/bulletins/{BulletinList,BulletinDetail,OpenPdf.ts}` with `openBulletinFile({ bucket, path, mimeType, fileName })` (legacy `expo-file-system/legacy` download to `cacheDirectory` → `getContentUriAsync` → `IntentLauncher.startActivityAsync('android.intent.action.VIEW', { data, flags: 1, type })`, browser fallback on `ActivityNotFoundException`, iOS branch marked "Phase 3 (6.4) verifies"), `pickOpener(mimeType, platform)` → `'intent' | 'inline_image' | 'share' | 'browser'`, the 4.2a "Showing saved content — you appear to be offline" bar, `src/features/feed/{AnnouncementCard,AnnouncementDetail}.tsx` (the detail carries the `TODO(5.4)` comment where a linked document should render), `src/features/more/MoreMenu.tsx` (rows Bulletins, Notification settings, Change password, Switch church, Sign out, footer links), `src/lib/deep-links.ts` (`resolveNotificationTarget` — unchanged here: no document push exists). If 5.2a/5.3b ran before you, `MoreMenu` may already carry Directory and Calendar rows.
- Mobile dependencies already installed by 4.1a/4.2a via `npx expo install`: `expo-file-system`, `expo-intent-launcher`, `expo-sharing`, `expo-web-browser`, `expo-image`, `react-native-paper`, `@tanstack/react-query`, `expo-router`. Nothing new is needed for this step.
- Web 5.4a shipped in `@church/db`: `queries/documents.ts` — `listPublishedDocuments(db, orgId, { category?, limit? })` (= `publish_at <= now()`; RLS additionally applies `user_in_group`), `listDocuments`, `getDocument(db, id)`, `listDocumentCategories(db, orgId)`; `keys.ts` — `queryKeys.documents.list(orgId)`, `.documents.detail(id)`, `.documents.categories(orgId)`, `.signedUrl(bucket, path)`. In `@church/domain`: `BUCKETS.documents` (50 MiB; eight MIME types: `application/pdf`, `image/jpeg`, `image/png`, `text/plain`, `application/msword`, `application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document`, `application/vnd.ms-excel`, `application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet`), `documents.ts` — `documentKind(mime)` → `'pdf' | 'image' | 'text' | 'word' | 'excel'` and `DOCUMENT_KIND_LABELS`; `limits.ts` — `SIGNED_URL_TTL_SECONDS`, `SIGNED_URL_CACHE_MS`; `dates.ts` formatting helpers; `errors.ts` — `toDomainError`. Read the real signatures first (5.4a's HANDOFF hand-off line names them); if 5.4a's agent named something differently, follow the code and note the difference in HANDOFF.
- Database facts (DESIGN §6; `supabase/migrations/9999_init.sql`): `documents` select for members = active member ∧ `publish_at <= now()` ∧ `app.user_in_group(audience_group_id)` (null = everyone); `storage.objects` select on bucket `documents` = `app.can_read_object` = the row is visible to the caller — the app signs URLs with the member's session and never proxies bytes; `announcements.document_id` is a nullable FK, so an announcement stays visible when its document is not; the row shape is `id, org_id, title, category, audience_group_id, storage_path, mime_type, file_size_bytes, publish_at, created_by` (+ `description` if 5.4a found the column — read `packages/db/src/database.types.ts`). `notification_kind` has no `document` value: no push payload will ever carry `/documents/<id>`, so `resolveNotificationTarget` and 4.3's preference switches stay as they are.
- Founder decision 10 (Supabase Free): files are ≤ 50 MiB and every download counts toward the 5 GB monthly egress — cache files by document id and never re-download an unchanged document.

## Build
1. **Data hooks** `src/features/documents/useDocuments.ts`: `useDocuments(orgId)` = `useQuery({ queryKey: queryKeys.documents.list(orgId), queryFn: () => listPublishedDocuments(supabase, orgId, {}), staleTime: 5 * 60_000 })` — filter by category in memory (one query, persisted for offline reading); `useDocument(id)` = `useQuery({ queryKey: queryKeys.documents.detail(id), queryFn: () => getDocument(supabase, id) })` with `initialData` taken from the list cache when the row is present; pure helpers in `src/features/documents/format.ts`: `groupByCategory(rows)` → `{ category: string | null; items }[]` sorted by category name, `null` ("Other") last, items `publish_at desc`; `categoriesOf(rows)` → sorted distinct categories; `documentSizeLabel(bytes)` (KB under 1 MB, otherwise MB with one decimal); `documentFileName(row)` → `<title slug>.<ext from mime via extensionForMime>` (safe for the file system, never the storage uuid). Pull-to-refresh invalidates `queryKeys.documents.list(orgId)`.
2. **List** `app/(app)/documents/index.tsx` + `src/features/documents/DocumentList.tsx`: header "Documents"; a horizontal chip row built from `categoriesOf(rows)` with "All" first (no second query — comment why); `SectionList` from `groupByCategory` (a section header per category; a flat list when no row has a category); row = kind icon by `documentKind`, title, `category · size · <published date>` through the domain date helpers; tap → `documents/[id]`; `RefreshControl`; empty state "Your church has not shared any documents yet"; error state with Retry; when the persisted cache serves rows and the refetch fails, keep them with the 4.2a offline bar (reuse the component; do not copy it).
3. **Detail and open** `app/(app)/documents/[id].tsx` + `src/features/documents/DocumentDetail.tsx`: title, description (when present in the row type), category, `DOCUMENT_KIND_LABELS[kind]`, size, published date; primary button "Open document"; secondary "Share". Open logic: do NOT copy `openBulletinFile` — generalise it: move the download → content-URI → intent → fallback body from `src/features/bulletins/OpenPdf.ts` into `src/lib/open-file.ts` as `openStoredFile({ bucket, path, mimeType, fileName, cacheKey, expectedSize })`, keep `openBulletinFile` as a thin wrapper so 4.2a's callers and tests stay untouched, and call `openStoredFile({ bucket: 'documents', path: row.storage_path, mimeType: row.mime_type, fileName: documentFileName(row), cacheKey: row.id, expectedSize: row.file_size_bytes })` here. Extend `pickOpener(mimeType, platform)` (table-tested): Android → `application/pdf`, the two Word types, the two Excel types and `text/plain` → `'intent'` (ACTION_VIEW with the exact MIME type; Google Docs/Sheets, WPS, Drive PDF viewer or the system viewer pick it up), `image/jpeg` / `image/png` → `'inline_image'`; iOS (untested until 6.4) → `'share'` for everything but images. Fallback chain inside `openStoredFile`: when no activity handles the intent (`ActivityNotFoundException` or `startActivityAsync` rejecting) → `expo-sharing` `shareAsync(localUri, { mimeType })` with the toast "No app can open this file. Choose an app to share it with."; only when `Sharing.isAvailableAsync()` is false → `WebBrowser.openBrowserAsync(signedUrl)`. Cache: `FileSystem.cacheDirectory + 'anacast-files/' + cacheKey + '.' + ext`; before downloading, `getInfoAsync` — reuse the cached file when it exists and its `size` equals `expectedSize`, otherwise delete and re-download; on a 403 or an expired signed URL → `remint()` once and retry, then the friendly error "This file could not be opened. Pull to refresh and try again."; show a progress indicator (`createDownloadResumable` progress callback) during download.
4. **Images**: `image/jpeg` / `image/png` render inline on the detail screen with `expo-image` (`contentFit: 'contain'`), same "Share" button — the 4.2a bulletin pattern.
5. **Linked document on announcements**: in `src/features/feed/AnnouncementDetail.tsx` replace the `TODO(5.4)` comment with `LinkedDocumentCard` (`src/features/documents/LinkedDocumentCard.tsx`): when `announcement.document_id` is set, `useDocument(document_id)`; while loading render a small skeleton; when the query returns a row render a card (kind icon, title, size, chevron) that navigates to `documents/[id]`; when it returns no row (RLS-hidden, scheduled, deleted) render nothing — no "not available" text, because the member must not learn that a restricted document exists. In `src/features/feed/AnnouncementCard.tsx` show a paper-clip icon when `document_id` is set (presence of the id only — no query per card). If `getAnnouncement` / `listFeed` do not select `document_id`, add the column to their explicit column lists additively (with a test) and record it.
6. **More tab**: in `src/features/more/MoreMenu.tsx` add the row Documents → `/documents` in the DESIGN §10 order ("Phase 2/3 add Directory, Calendar, Documents, Surveys, My household …"): after Directory and Calendar when 5.2a/5.3b already added them, otherwise directly under Bulletins. Keep the remaining rows and the footer untouched.
7. **Routing**: register `documents/index` and `documents/[id]` in the stack layout where 4.x declares `bulletins/[id]` (titles "Documents" / "Document"); `documents/[id]` must work when opened cold with only an id (same rule as `announcements/[id]`), because the announcement card may be the first screen a member reaches after a push tap.
8. **Accessibility and copy**: rows are `Pressable` with `accessibilityRole="button"` and `accessibilityLabel` "<title>, <kind label>, <size>"; text sizes respect the system font scale; all strings English, sentence case; the empty state, the no-viewer toast and the open-failure message are the only new copy.
9. **Tests** (Vitest, node; `vi.mock` for `@church/db` and every `expo-*` module; use whichever renderer 4.x already uses — add no test library): `format.test.ts` (`groupByCategory` puts `null` last and sorts items newest first; `categoriesOf` dedupes; `documentSizeLabel` 512 KB / 1.5 MB; `documentFileName` slug + extension for a docx row), the extended `pickOpener` table (every MIME in `BUCKETS.documents.allowedMimeTypes` yields a defined opener on `android` and on `ios`), `open-file.test.ts` (intent rejection → `Sharing.shareAsync` called once; sharing unavailable → `openBrowserAsync`; cached file with matching size → no download; size mismatch → re-download; 403 → `remint` called once then success), `LinkedDocumentCard.test.tsx` (renders nothing when the query resolves to `null`; renders the title when a row exists), `openBulletinFile` still passes its 4.2a tests unchanged.
10. **Docs**: `docs/MEDIA.md` (4.4) — a "Documents" section: which app opens each type on Android, the share fallback, the cache path and size check, the egress note; `docs/MOBILE_BUILD.md` device checklist — a "Documents (5.4b)" block holding the manual checks from Verify; `apps/mobile/README.md` "Mobile playback and files" — one line for documents.

## Constraints
- Mobile native dependency versions come only from `npx expo install <pkg>`; this step needs no new native module — if you believe one is required, stop and ask. `react` stays `catalog:` (19.2.3).
- No elevated key on the device; the app reads `documents` and signs URLs with the member's session under RLS. Never persist signed URLs (`queryKeys.signedUrl` + `meta.persist: false`).
- Do not touch `supabase/`, `apps/web`, `src/lib/deep-links.ts`, push registration, or `settings/notifications`. Additive changes to `@church/db` / `@church/domain` only if 5.4a missed something you need, each with a test and a HANDOFF note.
- Do not build directory, events, join-code or survey screens; do not add a documents push preference (there is no such kind); do not add a documents web view.
- No model identifiers in commits or files; no secrets; never `supabase db push` or `supabase db reset`.

## Verify
- `pnpm turbo lint typecheck test` → green (the mobile Vitest suite included).
- `pnpm --filter mobile exec expo-doctor` (or the `doctor` script 4.1a added — same pinned binary as `npx expo-doctor`) → no issues; `cd apps/mobile && npx expo export --platform android` → bundle written, no missing-module errors, and `documents/index` and `documents/[id]` appear in the exported route manifest.
- `pnpm --filter web build` → unchanged and green (you must not have touched web code; this proves it).
- `grep -rn "TODO(5.4)" apps/mobile` → no matches.
- Manual on a device (founder, EAS `preview` build — record outcomes in `docs/MOBILE_BUILD.md`): More → Documents lists the PDF that 5.4a's acceptance run uploaded for "Members" only when signed in as a member; tapping it opens the PDF viewer; a `.docx` opens in Docs/WPS or offers Share when no viewer exists; the second open of the same file makes no network request (cache); airplane mode → the list shows saved rows with the offline bar; an announcement with an attached document shows the card and opens the file; an attendee outside the document's audience sees the announcement with no card.

## Finish
- `HANDOFF.md`: State — the Phase 2 line gets `documents (mobile) ✔ (5.4b)`; feature table — Documents: Mobile UI `done (5.4b)`; "Decisions" — Android opens documents by MIME intent with Share fallback, files cached by document id with a size check, restricted linked documents render nothing; "Deviations from plan" — `openBulletinFile` generalised into `src/lib/open-file.ts` (wrapper kept), any `@church/db` / `@church/domain` name that differed from 5.4a's hand-off, any column added to the announcement queries; founder to-dos — the "Documents (5.4b)" device checklist to run at the next EAS build.
- Tick step 5.4b in `docs/TODO.md`; write `session_log.md`; commit `feat(mobile): documents list and open, linked document on announcements, More tab row`; push `main` (`git push origin main`) unless another branch was named. If something in the plan proves impossible or wrong, do the closest correct thing, record it in HANDOFF.md under "Deviations from plan", and report it in your final message.

The list uses `listPublishedDocuments` keyed `queryKeys.documents.list(orgId)`, groups rows by category with a chip filter ('All' first, uncategorised last), supports pull-to-refresh, and shows the 4.2a offline bar when served from the persisted cache.

`src/lib/open-file.ts` exports `openStoredFile(...)`; `openBulletinFile` is a thin wrapper whose 4.2a tests still pass; `pickOpener` returns a defined opener for every MIME type in `BUCKETS.documents.allowedMimeTypes` on android and ios (table test).

Opening a document downloads to `cacheDirectory/anacast-files/<document id>.<ext>`, reuses the cached file when its size matches `file_size_bytes`, remints the signed URL once on 403, opens via ACTION_VIEW with the exact MIME type, and falls back to `expo-sharing` then `expo-web-browser` (unit-tested with mocked expo modules).

`AnnouncementDetail` no longer contains `TODO(5.4)`; it renders `LinkedDocumentCard` for a `document_id` that resolves to a visible row and renders nothing when `getDocument` returns null; `AnnouncementCard` shows a paper-clip icon when `document_id` is set.
`MoreMenu` has a Documents row navigating to `/documents` in the DESIGN §10 order; `src/lib/deep-links.ts` and `settings/notifications` are unchanged (no document push kind).

Any later step naming `5.4` (G13 5.7; G14 if it references documents) should point at `5.4b`.

`documents.description`: G4's 1.6b `documentSchema` carries `description ≤ 4000 nullable`, but DESIGN §4.2 defines `documents` as the bulletins shape plus `category, audience_group_id` only — no `description`. 5.4a tells the agent to read `9999_init.sql` section (3) and drop the field (additively fixing `documentSchema`) if the column does not exist. G2 (1.2) or G4 (1.6b) should settle it while `9999_init.sql` is unfrozen; the assembler may want to ask G2 to add the column, since a document description is useful on both apps.

FK action on `announcements.document_id` (`on delete set null` vs `restrict`) is not stated in PLAN/DESIGN; 5.4a's delete flow handles both and records which one 1.2 chose. Recommend G2 make it `on delete set null` explicitly so deleting a document never blocks.

`documents.publish_at` nullability: like `bulletins` (G9 3.5b's open issue), the upload flow inserts the draft row with `publish_at = null`, but DESIGN §4.2 says `default now()` without stating nullability. 5.4a stops and asks if the column is `not null`. Documents have no push: `notification_kind` is `announcement, event, survey, bulletin` and `app.on_content_publish` is not attached to `documents`. 5.4a/5.4b treat 'create an announcement and attach the document' as the notify path and say so in the UI and docs.
